text: This report summarizes the findings of the Bloor West Village Heritage Conservation District (HCD) Study (the "HCD Study" or "Study") and recommends that the Toronto Preservation Board endorse staff's recommendations that the HCD Study not proceed to the Plan phase and affirm the list of individual properties with cultural heritage or interest within the Study area. In March 2015, City Council authorized and prioritized the Bloor West Village HCD Study. In November 2017, City staff, with a consultant team (Stantec Consulting Ltd.), initiated a study of this area to determine whether it merited designation under Part V of the Ontario Heritage Act (the "OHA"). The HCD Study included the survey, analysis, and evaluation of the Bloor West Village area and solicited feedback from a Community Advisory Group and the community.
